Lesson: When a prohibition or general negative covenant enumerates a list of itemized exceptions/carve-outs, and one of those enumerated exceptions itself states a specific numeric dollar (or other quantitative) limitation, that carve-out should be modeled as its own separately-represented quantitative permission rule with that figure as its capacityExpression - not left as a bare textual description with no separately-modeled economics. A carve-out with a stated cap is a basket in its own right, structurally, even when it appears inside a longer prose list of otherwise unlimited/qualitative carve-outs.
